steps.name: Upload coverage to Codecov
steps.run:
# Download and install Codecov uploader
curl -Os https://cli.codecov.io/latest/linux/codecov
chmod +x codecov

# Find all coverage files and upload them with flags based on folder names
find . -name "coverage-final.json" -path "*/coverage/*" | while read -r coverage_file; do
  # Extract the folder name that contains the coverage directory
  folder_name=$(echo "$coverage_file" | sed -E 's|.*/(.*)/coverage/.*|\1|')
  echo "Uploading coverage for $folder_name from $coverage_file"

  # Upload to codecov with folder name as flag
  ./codecov upload-coverage -f "$coverage_file" -F "$folder_name" -Z --disable-search
done

pipelines.name: Prepare Release

steps.name: Validate version format and existence
steps.run:
VERSION="$VERSION_INPUT"
TAG="v$VERSION"
REPO="${{ github.repository }}"

# Check for stable or RC semver format
if [[ ! "$VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-rc\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*))?$ ]]; then
  echo "❌ Invalid version format for '$VERSION'. Expected: x.y.z or x.y.z-rc.N"
  exit 1
fi

# Check for tag existence
if gh api repos/$REPO/git/ref/tags/$TAG \
     --silent >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "❌ Tag '$TAG' already exists"
  exit 1
fi

echo "✅ Version '$VERSION' is valid and available"

steps.name: Check Crowdin PRs
steps.run:
# Fetch open Crowdin PR
OPEN=$(gh pr list --state open --search "New Crowdin updates" --json url --limit 10)
# Fetch merged Crowdin PR in Next Release milestone
MERGED=$(gh pr list --state merged --search "New Crowdin updates milestone:\"Next Release\"" --json url --limit 10)

# Build URL lists
OPEN_LIST=$(echo "$OPEN" | jq -r '.[] .url' | paste -sd ", " -)
MERGED_LIST=$(echo "$MERGED" | jq -r '.[] .url' | paste -sd ", " -)

# Determine checkbox: checked if no open PR
if [ -z "$OPEN_LIST" ]; then
  CHECKBOX="[x]"
else
  CHECKBOX="[ ]"
fi

# Combine lists
if [ -n "$OPEN_LIST" ] && [ -n "$MERGED_LIST" ]; then
  PRS="$OPEN_LIST, $MERGED_LIST"
else
  PRS="${OPEN_LIST}${MERGED_LIST}"
fi

# If list is empty
if [ -z "$PRS" ]; then
  PRS="No Crowdin PR found"
  CHECKBOX="[x]"
fi

echo "crowdin_task=- $CHECKBOX Merge Crowdin PR: $PRS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

echo "✅ Crowdin PR check completed"

steps.name: Generate release notes and update versions
steps.run:
VERSION="$DIRECTUS_VERSION"

echo "🔄 Running changeset version..."

if [[ "$VERSION" == *"-"* ]]; then
  IS_PRERELEASE=true

  if [ -f .changeset/pre.json ]; then
    PRE_MODE=$(node -p "require('./.changeset/pre.json').mode")
    PRE_TAG=$(node -p "require('./.changeset/pre.json').tag")

    if [ "$PRE_MODE" != "pre" ] || [ "$PRE_TAG" != "rc" ]; then
      echo "❌ Expected existing prerelease mode for rc, found mode '$PRE_MODE' and tag '$PRE_TAG'"
      exit 1
    fi

    echo "➡️ Continuing existing rc prerelease mode..."
  else
    echo "➡️ Entering rc prerelease mode..."
    pnpm changeset pre enter rc
  fi
else
  IS_PRERELEASE=false

  if [ -f .changeset/pre.json ]; then
    PRE_MODE=$(node -p "require('./.changeset/pre.json').mode")

    if [ "$PRE_MODE" = "pre" ]; then
      echo "➡️ Exiting prerelease mode..."
      pnpm changeset pre exit
    elif [ "$PRE_MODE" = "exit" ]; then
      echo "➡️ Prerelease mode already marked for exit..."
    else
      echo "❌ Unexpected changeset prerelease mode '$PRE_MODE'"
      exit 1
    fi
  fi
fi

echo "is_prerelease=$IS_PRERELEASE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

# Capture the changeset version output without letting `set -e`
# abort before we've printed it (default shell runs with -eo pipefail)
set +e
OUTPUT=$(pnpm changeset version 2>&1)
STATUS=$?
set -e

# Always surface the output so failures are visible in the logs
echo "$OUTPUT"

if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "❌ 'pnpm changeset version' failed with exit code $STATUS"
  exit 1
fi

# Extract release notes from the output
# The release notes generator outputs between the divider lines
RELEASE_NOTES=$(echo "$OUTPUT" | awk -v RS="==============================================================" 'NR==3 {print}' | sed '1{/^$/d}')

# Output release notes
{
  echo "release_notes<<EOF"
  echo "$RELEASE_NOTES"
  echo "EOF"
} >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

# Verify version was updated in main package
PACKAGE_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./directus/package.json').version")
if [ "$PACKAGE_VERSION" != "$VERSION" ]; then
  echo "❌ Version mismatch: package.json shows $PACKAGE_VERSION, expected $VERSION"
  exit 1
fi

echo "✅ Version updated successfully to $VERSION"

steps.name: Verify changeset cleanup
steps.run:
# Count remaining changeset files (excluding config)
CHANGESET_COUNT=$(find .changeset -name "*.md" -not -name "config.json" | wc -l)
if [ $CHANGESET_COUNT -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "❌ Changesets not properly cleared. Found $CHANGESET_COUNT remaining files:"
  find .changeset -name "*.md" -not -name "config.json"
  exit 1
fi

if [ -f .changeset/pre.json ]; then
  echo "❌ Prerelease state was not cleared"
  exit 1
fi

echo "✅ Changesets cleared successfully"

steps.name: Create release PR
steps.run:
VERSION="$VERSION_INPUT"
TAG="v$VERSION"
BRANCH_NAME="release-$VERSION"
PR_TITLE="Release $VERSION"

# Build the PR body content
PR_BODY=$(cat <<'EOF'
### ✅ Release Checklist
- [x] Changesets processed
- [x] Package versions updated
- [x] Release notes generated
${{ steps.crowdin-check.outputs.crowdin_task }}
- [ ] PR reviewed and approved
- [ ] E2E tests passed

### 🚀 Release Notes
```md
${{ steps.changeset-version.outputs.release_notes }}
```
EOF
)

# Configure git and commit changes
git checkout -b "$BRANCH_NAME"
git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
git add -A
git commit -m "Release $VERSION"
git push origin "$BRANCH_NAME" --force

# Look for existing open PR with this branch
EXISTING_PR=$(gh pr list \
  --state open \
  --head "$BRANCH_NAME" \
  --json number \
  --jq '.[0].number' || echo "")

if [ -n "$EXISTING_PR" ]; then
  echo "🔄 Updating existing PR #$EXISTING_PR"
  gh pr edit $EXISTING_PR \
    --title "$PR_TITLE" \
    --body "$PR_BODY"
  echo "pr_number=$EXISTING_PR" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  echo "new_pr=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
else
  echo "✨ Creating new PR"
  NEW_PR=$(gh pr create \
    --title "$PR_TITLE" \
    --body "$PR_BODY" \
    --label "Release" \
    --label "Run E2E" \
    --label "No Changeset" \
    --head "$BRANCH_NAME" \
    --base "main" \
    --draft=false \
    | grep -o '[0-9]\+$')
  echo "pr_number=$NEW_PR" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  echo "new_pr=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
fi
echo "tag=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

steps.name: Notify Slack
steps.run:
PAYLOAD=$(jq -n \
  --arg tag "${{ steps.create-pr.outputs.tag }}" \
  --arg pr_number "${{ steps.create-pr.outputs.pr_number }}" \
  '{tag: $tag, pr_number: $pr_number}')
curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data "$PAYLOAD" \
  "$SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL"

steps.name: Prepare

platform=${{ matrix.platform }}

steps.name: Export digest
steps.run:
mkdir -p ${{ runner.temp }}/digests
digest="${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}"
touch "${{ runner.temp }}/digests/${digest#sha256:}"

steps.name: Move cache
steps.run:
rm -rf /tmp/.buildx-cache
mv /tmp/.buildx-cache-new /tmp/.buildx-cache

steps.name: Create manifest list and push to Docker Hub
steps.run:
docker buildx imagetools create \
  $(jq -cr '.tags | map(select(startswith("docker.io"))) | map("-t " + .) | join(" ")' <<< '${{ steps.meta.outputs.json }}') \
  $(printf '${{ env.DOCKERHUB_IMAGE }}@sha256:%s ' *)

steps.name: Create manifest list and push to GHCR
steps.run:
docker buildx imagetools create \
  $(jq -cr '.tags | map(select(startswith("ghcr.io"))) | map("-t " + .) | join(" ")' <<< '${{ steps.meta.outputs.json }}') \
  $(printf '${{ env.GHCR_IMAGE }}@sha256:%s ' *)

steps.name: Get Docker Hub manifest digest
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
DIGEST=$(docker buildx imagetools inspect ${{ env.DOCKERHUB_IMAGE }}:${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }} --format '{{json .Manifest.Digest}}' | tr -d '"')
if [ -z "$DIGEST" ]; then
  echo "::error::Failed to get manifest digest for ${{ env.DOCKERHUB_IMAGE }}:${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}"
  exit 1
fi
echo "digest=$DIGEST" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

steps.name: Sign Docker Hub image with GitHub OIDC Token
steps.run: cosign sign --yes --recursive ${{ env.DOCKERHUB_IMAGE }}@${{ steps.get-digest.outputs.digest }}

steps.name: Inspect Docker Hub image
steps.run: docker buildx imagetools inspect ${{ env.DOCKERHUB_IMAGE }}:${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}

steps.name: Inspect GHCR image
steps.run: docker buildx imagetools inspect ${{ env.GHCR_IMAGE }}:${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}

steps.name: Build builder stage for build-time SBOM
Generate build-time SBOM

syft "directus-builder-sbom:${{ matrix.variant.name }}" \
  -o "spdx-json=directus-${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}${{ matrix.variant.suffix }}.buildtime.spdx.json" \

steps.name: Generate run-time SBOM
steps.run:
syft "${{ env.DOCKERHUB_IMAGE }}:${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}${{ matrix.variant.suffix }}" \
  --platform linux/amd64 \
  -o "spdx-json=directus-${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}${{ matrix.variant.suffix }}.runtime.spdx.json" \
  -o "cyclonedx-json=directus-${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}${{ matrix.variant.suffix }}.runtime.cdx.json"

steps.name: Attach SBOMs to release
